findings.finding: The swimlane HANDOFF label mask overflows under a substituted font
findings.current_state: With remote fonts blocked (0 FontFace entries, against 37 loaded in the paired render), the HANDOFF label keeps 11.73px of slack on each side of its mask, 3.00px above and 0.40px below. The six pixels the band test flags sit on the elbow corner and the vertical connector, not on a glyph. The prior run's method counted ink anywhere in a 6px margin, so a 1px antialiasing shift on an adjacent stroke read as label spill; tightening the band to 4px and reading the crop shows no glyph outside the mask.
